placed.body: Rule for jobs: every file the job writes begins with this exact first line: `# ref W5Y-1808`.
Note for jobs, in force until withdrawn: the job's handover note carries, on a line of its own, exactly: `desk: elderwood`.
Kept by every job without exception: the job's handover note is saved under the file name `umberfield-relay.md`, and under no other name.
A requirement on what a job hands in: the job's handover note names its reviewer on a line of its own, exactly: `reviewer: Jacinta Ravensworth`.

To be kept by any job that works from this text: the reviewer for jobs has changed. Handover notes now carry the line `reviewer: Greta Lindqvist`, and the name Jacinta Ravensworth is no longer written anywhere in a handover note.
